mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate environment compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors seek yield in equities.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 1.0% (12-month rolling window), or Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% for three consecutive months, restrictive monetary policy increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC remains above 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: Joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 6.5%), a decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals worsening labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In UNRATE > 6.5% periods, PAYEMS declines fail to predict negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC for PAYEMS in regime is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A persistently high unemployment rate (UNRATE > 5.5%) suppresses consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in economic weakness.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 99.0 for two consecutive months signals manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate earnings growth expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 99.0 for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC remains above 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market expansion regime (HOUST > 850.0), concurrent GDP acceleration (GDPC1 > 1.5% annualized) signals robust consumer spending and corporate investment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In HOUST > 850.0 periods, GDPC1 acceleration fails to predict positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC for GDPC1 in regime is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%) and low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 1.0%) indicates stagflationary pressure with constrained policy response, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to elevated risk and margin compression.
failure_condition: Joint condition of CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS < 1.0% fails to predict negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.03.
